page.notes: The woodcut initial E is a decorative block showing a figure and foliage; the first word is printed in small capitals "EST". The signature at the foot reads "4", set beside a small ornament, which is uncertain. The catchword "tiam," is the start of the next page's text and is read from the scan at the right foot.
